svg.title: Grounded agent request sequence
svg.desc: Trace the path from an authenticated UI through retrieval, model execution, conversation state and a grounded response. This adapts the baseline's agent workflow. Source references must be validated; a model answer alone is not evidence that a source supports it.

text.tspan: Adapted Microsoft enterprise flow | REFERENCE DESIGN - NOT DEPLOYED
Solid: primary flow / semantic relationship Dashed: supporting evidence, control or return
Public Microsoft sources: MS03 | See companion documentation for scope and exclusions.
